handshake.resumeToken: optional canonical base64url in Hello; required rotated canonical base64url in HelloAccepted

signingPayload.canonicalBytes: After rejecting challenge lifetimes outside 1,000..300,000ms and expiresAt <= caller nowMilliseconds, ASCII magic ENCHWSHELLO, u8 1, then u32-big-endian UTF-8 byte length and bytes for: hello type, challenge protocolVersion, connectionNonce, issuedAt, expiresAt, ownerID, vaultID, authEpoch, credentialEpoch, generationEpoch, hello protocolVersion, hello connectionNonce, resumeToken or literal null, deviceID, hello authEpoch.

syncChangeProof.canonicalBytes: ASCII magic ENCHSYNC, u8 signingPayloadVersion, then u32-big-endian UTF-8 byte length and bytes for: protocolVersion, vaultID, deviceID, authEpoch, credentialEpoch, generationEpoch, sessionNonce, assertionExpiresAt, operationID, sourceKind, payloadSHA256, causalVersion-or-empty, frameID, payloadBase64.
